title: Check Billing Activity
description: Verify if there are any unexpected charges linked to the IAM user's activity.
recommended_next_focus: Look for anomalies in the billing data related to the IAM user.

title: Gather Logging Gaps
description: Search for any missing or inconsistent logs that could indicate the origin of the unauthorized access.
recommended_next_focus: Examine areas where logs might have been missed or altered.

title: Investigate Activity Around Invoke
description: Investigate the recent activity around the Invoke call by customer-api.
recommended_next_focus: Identify the IAM user's last known good session and investigate further.
